column3: “Cush” is rendered “Ethiopia,” “every foreigner” (or “Arabia”) as “all Arabia,” and “land of the covenant” as “land that is in league.”
“Migdol Syene” is rendered “From Migdol to Syene.”
“Memphis distress daily” is difficult; NASB has “Memphis will have distresses daily.”
“Tahpanhes” is spelled “Tehaphnehes,” and “it will withhold” is rendered “will be dark,” following many manuscripts.
